Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

get.description: Answers the tenants the calling account holds an active membership in, with each tenant's identifier and alias. A membership that is suspended is left out, as is a tenant whose roster state is not active and an identifier the roster does not carry. The list is ordered by identifier and is empty rather than absent when the caller holds none. The route resolves no tenant and requires no permission: every authenticated caller reads its own memberships. A membership or roster read that cannot answer is a 503, never an empty list.

schema.description: The tenants the calling account holds an active membership in.

tenants.description: The tenants whose membership is active and whose roster row is active, ordered by identifier. Empty when the caller holds none.

alias.description: The tenant's alias, the name the request surface addresses it by.

200.description: The tenants the caller holds an active membership in

503.description: The membership table or the roster snapshot could not answer

get.summary: List the tenants the caller holds an active membership in
